units: microseconds per instrumented attempt unless labeled otherwise

heldout.fresh_gate_note: Fresh gate samples from frozen stages/base; not the unserialized historical S10 or S13 contexts.

instrumentation.semantics: Original attempt body and call frame retained; phase context managers finish entering before each body. No additional wrapper attempt frame is present while sys._getframe traverses callers.

limitations: Each exclusive integer bucket sums exactly to its instrumented attempt. Timers/context managers allocate and add overhead; these are classification measurements, not headline timings or an uninstrumented speedup.

Inclusive method envelopes may overlap and must not be added. Exclusive load excludes nested arrays work; exclusive write-back excludes nested result conversion. Compare historical phases only as separate contexts.

Bookkeeping includes uncovered dispatch, loop/branch/counter work, recorder transitions, and call/return observer overhead. Fine buckets also retain some timer overhead. No overhead subtraction or timing bound is claimed.
Native timing includes the Python-to-AOT extension call. Input copying, reference recomputation, resets, and structural checks occur outside timers.
The attempt is source-instrumented in memory only. Original baseline files and AOT artifacts remain hash-identical; no digest check is bypassed.

barnes_wave15.note: Diagnostic timers add overhead; not an uninstrumented performance result. Native entries include retries; actual successful mode counts and Python fallbacks are in runner. Other attempt time includes preparation/compilation and unmeasured conversion/commit work. Timers attribute only the selected region.

fft_historical_wave11.note: Diagnostic timers add overhead. Native includes Python AOT adapter/status result; other includes shape preparation and binding. Only selected compiled functions are instrumented; SciMark other components remain Python. No kernel-wide subtraction from independently timed minima.

raytrace_historical_wave11.note: Diagnostic timers add overhead; not an uninstrumented performance result. Native entries include retries; actual successful mode counts and Python fallbacks are in runner. Other attempt time includes preparation/compilation and unmeasured conversion/commit work. Timers attribute only the selected region.

barnes_separate_heavy_probe_wave13.warning: Instrumented copy adds QPC timer switches at fine-grained operations; these are observed diagnostic times, not an additive decomposition of the old 13.6ms. Ranges/conversions and contract map operations not separated from graph walk; all labels are exact scope definitions.

heldout_observed_attempt_aggregate.meaning: Sum of these 36 instrumented attempts, with observed counts only; not a workload-population total, a gate estimate, or a speedup bound. No kernel context is pooled.

missing: Barnes: named other subcomponents not separated in current wave15 phase record; first preparation is included in coarse residual.
FFT: result conversion/status is included in native; no separate result number. Shape preparation and binding are combined in other. No named-other partition.
Raytrace: only one cold attempt with seven native entries; warmed per-call load/guards/result/writeback and named-other partition are absent.
No current integrated wave16 context is measured here. Existing instruments classify costs with observer overhead; a causal direct-access saving is not obtained by summing their buckets.

scimark.method: five fresh rotating processes, each rung outputs checked; signed order-dependent deltas telescope, no pooling with other cohorts

raytrace.method: five fresh rotating processes, each rung outputs checked; signed order-dependent deltas telescope, no pooling with other cohorts
